caption: The drawing depicts a delicate, semi-circular lace fan pattern, rendered in fine black lines against a beige or off-white background. The fan occupies the majority of the center lower half of the composition and is ornate, featuring a wide floral motif and circular decorative elements along the scalloped curved edge. In the upper left quadrant, there is a smaller, separate detail showing a lace design, possibly a fragment or a different view of the same lacework, rendered in the same black line style. Below the main fan shape, near the bottom edge of the image, there is a linear scale labeled “Scale ¾” = 1’” that runs horizontally and is marked with units. The background of the drawing is plain, and the total composition is set within a faint rectangular border. The artist’s name "Edith Magnette" appears in small text near the lower left corner inside the rectangle.
title: Handmade Embroidery
